title: "Building the Cohort"

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Define the cohort before running models

Write inclusion and exclusion criteria in plain language before coding them.

Example:

```text
Initial disease-site cohort
→ diagnosis years
→ age restriction
→ histology restriction
→ known exposure
→ known outcome
→ valid staging
→ analytic cohort
```

The script should record the number of patients remaining after every step.
